cards.imageAlt: Figure 16，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Describe what is shown in the picture.
cards.audioTextZh: 请描述图中展示的是什么。
cards.referenceText: The picture shows food onboard. The meals in the airplane are prepared by airline catering services.
cards.referenceTextZh: 图中展示的是飞机餐，飞机餐是由航空公司提供的餐饮服务。

cards.audioText: Can passengers bring food in the airplane?
cards.audioTextZh: 乘客可以将食物带入飞机吗？
cards.referenceText: Passengers can bring certain foods on an airplane, but not all are allowed. Because there is limitation on the size of the carry-on baggage, and the liquid quantity is also limited strictly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 乘客在飞机上可以携带某些食物，但并非所有食物都被允许带入飞机。因为随身行李的尺寸有限制，并且液体数量也有严格的限定。

cards.audioText: Do the captain and the co-pilot have the same food in the cockpit?
cards.audioTextZh: 机长和副驾驶的食物是否相同？
cards.referenceText: Yes, in our company we eat the same food in the cockpit. / No, the captain and the co-pilot in the same flight have different foods, or if they have the same food, they must stagger for one hour to have meals. Because if there is anything wrong with the food (toxic/rotting/expired/bad food), they may get sick in flight. It may lead to food poisoning, even pilot’s incapacitation, which will be a very dangerous situation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 相同，我们公司驾驶舱内的食物是相同的。/ 不同，机长和副驾驶会食用不同的食物。或者如果机长和副驾驶食用相同的食物，两人需要间隔1小时用餐，因为如果食物有问题（有毒/腐坏/过期/变质），他们可能在飞行途中生病。有可能导致食物中毒，甚至飞行员失能，这种情况非常危险。

cards.audioText: What are symptoms of food poisoning?
cards.audioTextZh: 食物中毒的症状有哪些？
cards.referenceText: Common case of food poisoning usually includes the following symptoms: abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, mild fever, weakness, nausea, headaches, etc.
cards.referenceTextZh: 食物中毒的常见症状如下：腹痛、腹泻、呕吐，低烧、乏力、恶心和头疼等。

cards.audioText: Supposing the passenger food poisoning occurs in your flight, as a pilot, what will you perform?
cards.audioTextZh: 假设你的航班中发生乘客食物中毒，作为飞行员，你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: Firstly, I need to make sure if the condition is serious and hard to handle. I will ask flight attendants to look after the passengers and give them basic medical assistance. At the same time, cabin crew will make a PA to find if there are doctors on board. If there is no doctor on board, we need to collect the sick passenger's excreta or vomit for further check. If it's serious, I must contact ATC to request a diversion to the nearest suitable airport and provide the passengers medical treatment as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh:
首先我需要确认情况的严重性，是否难以处理。我会让乘务员照顾乘客并给乘
基本的医疗救助。乘务员会广播找医生，如果飞机上没有医生，要把旅客的呕吐物以及排
物保存好以便下机以后提供检查。如果情况严重，我就必须联系ATC并要求改航至适合的最近的机场，并尽快为乘客提供治疗。

cards.audioText: If you have a flight tomorrow, what would you like to eat?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果明天你有飞行任务，你会吃哪种食物？
cards.referenceText: If I have a flight tomorrow, I will eat something light and fresh, such as porridge, vegetables, fruits, cereals and so on, for fear that I feel unwell in flight due to bad food.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果明天我有飞行任务，我会选择低热量、新鲜的食物，例如粥、蔬菜、水果、谷物等，防止因食物问题在飞行时感到不舒服。

cards.audioText: What do you think of the food safety in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对飞机上的食物安全怎么看？
cards.referenceText: I think the food safety is one of the most important things to be ensured. Airlines should always make sure the food provided is safe and clean. At the same time, relevant medical measures need to be well prepared.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为确保食品安全是最重要的事情之一。航空公司一定要确保提供的食品是安全干净的，同时相关医疗措施要准备好。

cards.audioText: What can cause a pilot to lose his ability to fly the airplane? What’s the most serious situation?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员在飞行途中失能的原因是什么？最危险的情况是什么？
cards.referenceText: I suppose if a pilot feels increasingly fatigued, shaky and nauseous, he may fall in a dead faint and lose ability, that is incapacitation, such condition can cause a pilot to lose his capability to fly or control the airplane. If the pilot in command is incapacitated and no one is clearly aware of the circumstances, the situation will become most serious, because the aircraft may lose control and it would be a disaster.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果一个飞行员感到越来越疲乏、虚弱和恶心，他可能会昏迷并在飞行途中失能，这种情况会让飞行员无法控制飞机。如果机长失能，没有其他人清楚当时的飞行情况，这是最危险的，因为飞机无人控制，可能会引发一场灾难。
